mcq_drop.why: ambiguous: Taniyurs were often brahmadeya villages, so 'Taniyurs - Brahmin villages' is arguable; key depends on it

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: a very large village administered as a single unit = Taniyur (option 4), key says 2 (Kottam)

patterns: APPSC asks Chola land/administrative terms as single-fact items (e.g. Taniyur = large village as single unit); UPSC pairs Eripatti, Ghatikas, Taniyurs.
Other PSCs: Chola = famous naval power; navy built by Rajaraja I; king named successor in his lifetime; land revenue 1/6.
Traps: Taniyur is not 'a village donated to a single Brahmin'; Kottam/Valanadu/Nadu/Kurram hierarchy is used as distractors.
App coverage is broader (officials, Leiden plates, Burton Stein) and mostly sound; PYQs focus on terminology and naval power.
AP angle (Eastern Chalukya Vengi viceroys, Kulottunga I) is an app addition that suits APPSC's state tilt.
